==English==

===Etymology===
{{root|en|ine-pro|*h₁em-}}
From {{der|en|la|assūmō|t=accept, take}}, from {{m|la|ad-|t=to, towards, at}} + {{m|la|sūmō|t=take up, assume}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{a|en|RP}}
** {{IPA|en|/əˈsjuːm/}}
*** {{audio|en|en-uk-assume.ogg|a=UK}}
** {{IPA|en|/əˈʃuːm/|a=yod-coalescence|aa=rare}}
* {{a|en|GA}}
** {{IPA|en|/əˈsum/|a=yod-dropping}}
*** {{audio|en|en-us-assume.ogg|a=US}}
* {{IPA|en|/əˈzuːm/|a=African, especially Nigerian;}}
* {{rhymes|en|uːm|s=2}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# To [[authenticate]] by means of [[belief]]; to [[surmise]]; to [[suppose]] to be [[true]], especially without [[proof]].
#: {{ux|en|We '''assume''' that, as her parents were dentists, she knows quite a bit about dentistry.}}
#* {{see more citations|en}}<!-- Please no more than 3–4 quotes here, further quotes only in 'Citations' (see [[WT:QUOTE]])-->
# To [[take on]] a [[position]], [[duty]] or form.
#: {{ux|en|Mr. Jones will '''assume''' the position of a lifeguard until a proper replacement is found.}}
#* {{RQ:Homer Pope Iliad|book=I|passage=Trembling they stand while Jove '''assumes''' the throne.}}
#* {{RQ:Besant Ivory Gate|chapter=Prologue|passage=Such a scandal as the prosecution of a brother for forgery—with a verdict of guilty—is a most truly horrible, deplorable, fatal thing. It takes the respectability out of a family perhaps at a critical moment, when the family is just '''assuming''' the robes of respectability: {{...}} it is a black spot which all the soaps ever advertised could never wash off.}}
#* {{see more citations|en}}<!-- Please no more than 3–4 quotes here, further quotes only in 'Citations' (see [[WT:QUOTE]])-->
# To adopt a [[feigned]] quality or [[manner]]; to claim without right; to [[arrogate]].
#: {{ux|en|He '''assumed''' an air of indifference.}}
#* {{RQ:Shakespeare Hamlet|III|iv|passage='''Assume''' a virtue, if you have it not.}}
#* '''a. 1809''',{{w|Beilby Porteus}}, ''sermon'':
#* {{see more citations|en}}<!-- Please no more than 3–4 quotes here, further quotes only in 'Citations' (see [[WT:QUOTE]])-->
# To [[receive]], [[adopt]] (a person).
#* {{RQ:Scott Ivanhoe|passage=The sixth was a young knight of lesser renown and lower rank, '''assumed''' into that honorable company.}}
# To [[adopt]] (an [[idea]] or [[cause]]).

====Conjugation====
{{en-conj|stem=assum|old=1}}
